title: Thai Sea Bass with French Pilaf
description: A flavorful Thai dish featuring sea bass cooked in a spicy sauce and served with a side of French pilaf.
instructions: Rinse the sea bass fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the sea bass with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the sea bass for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer it to the oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the sea bass is cooking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Stir in the fish sauce and chili flakes (if using).
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the sea bass with the French pilaf and spoon some of the spicy sauce over the top.
Garnish with additional garlic and serve immediately.
